learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will identify nouns and easily distinguish between Common, Proper, Collective, Material, and Abstract nouns.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Look around you! Everything you see, touch, or even feel has a name. These naming words are called Nouns. Today, we are going to sort these naming words into different special groups!

lesson_modules.module_title: 🏷️ Common and Proper Nouns (जातिवाचक और व्यक्तिवाचक संज्ञा)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Common nouns are general names for people, places, or things. Proper nouns are specific, special names for a particular person, place, or thing, and they ALWAYS start with a Capital Letter.
examples_or_templates: Common Nouns: city, boy, river, car
Proper Nouns: Delhi, Rahul, Ganga, Honda

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Words used to describe a group or collection of people, animals, or things as one whole unit are called Collective Nouns.

lesson_modules.module_title: 💭 Abstract and Material Nouns (भाववाचक और द्रव्यवाचक संज्ञा)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Abstract nouns are feelings, ideas, or qualities that we cannot touch or see (only feel or think about). Material nouns are substances or raw materials from which other things are made.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which of the following is a Proper Noun?
❓ What is the collective noun for a group of lions?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Circle the Abstract Noun in this sentence: 'King Solomon was known for his wisdom.'
subjective_practice.hint: Look for the word that describes a quality you cannot physically touch.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank with the correct Collective Noun: 'I gave my mother a _______ of flowers.'
subjective_practice.hint: It starts with a 'b' and rhymes with 'punch'.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write one Common Noun and one Proper Noun for the category 'Planet'.
subjective_practice.hint: The common noun is 'planet'. What is the specific name of the planet we live on?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🏠 Noun Hunt at Home
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Walk around your house and list: 3 Common Nouns, 3 Proper Nouns (like brand names on items), and try to find 2 Material Nouns (like glass, plastic, or wood)!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Nouns are naming words for people, places, animals, things, or ideas.
⭐ Proper nouns are special names (capitalized); common nouns are general everyday names.
⭐ Collective nouns name groups, Abstract nouns name feelings/ideas, and Material nouns name substances.
